title: Customer Loyalty Program Software | Square Loyalty

facts.fact: Square Loyalty offers a free trial lasting 30 days.
facts.quote: Try Square Loyalty free for 30 days.

facts.fact: Square says its built-in CRM tools that Square Loyalty integrates with are free.
facts.quote: Square Loyalty integrates with free [built-in CRM tools](https://squareup.com/us/en/point-of-sale/features/customer-directory)

facts.fact: In the VIP tier example, Bronze customers earn 1.5x points.
In the VIP tier example, Silver customers earn 2x points.
In the VIP tier example, Gold customers earn 3x points.
Square Loyalty lets businesses choose whether customers earn points by visits, amount spent, or items or categories purchased.
facts.quote: Choose whether customers earn points by visits, amount spent, or items or categories purchased

facts.fact: Transactional text notifications are sent automatically when a customer earns points or rewards.
facts.quote: Transactional text notifications are automatically sent when a customer earns points or rewards

facts.fact: Square states that its loyalty plan has no hidden fees or locked-in contracts and that customers can cancel or switch plans anytime.
facts.quote: No hidden fees or locked-in contracts. Cancel or switch plans anytime.

facts.fact: Square's customer testimonial from The Art of Donut's co-founder says the business has about 40,000 customers in its loyalty program (a vendor-published customer claim).
facts.quote: We have about 40,000 customers in our loyalty program.

facts.fact: According to Square, customers earn loyalty points on every purchase, including purchases paid with cash, from Square Point of Sale, Square Invoices, or a Square Online site.
facts.quote: Your customers earn points for every purchase they make — even when they use cash — from your Square Point of Sale App, Square Invoices, or your Square Online site.

facts.fact: Square states that merchants can set loyalty rewards to be earned per visit, per amount spent, per item, or by category.
facts.quote: Your customers can earn rewards per visit, per amount spent, per item, or by category.

facts.fact: Square states that Square Loyalty integrates directly with Square Marketing so merchants can send email and text message campaigns to loyalty customers.
facts.quote: Square Loyalty integrates directly with Square Marketing so you can send engaging campaigns to keep your customers coming back.

facts.fact: Square lists third-party app integrations for Square Loyalty, including Kyoo, Kiosk Buddy, Craver, PoppinPay, SpeedETab, Flash Order, Pepper, Incentivio, KIOS, and Grubbrr.
Square's page discloses that the businesses featured in its testimonials were fairly compensated by Square for their time.
facts.quote: These businesses were fairly compensated by Square for their time.
